description: This file is a shell script for managing firmware upgrades on Buffalo devices using U-Boot. It contains functions for checking images, upgrading firmware, and handling specific hardware configurations based on board models.

methods.name: buffalo_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image for compatibility, checksum, and size correctness before upgrade.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Handles the upgrade process for TRX + UBI formatted images, including erasure and writing to the firmware partition.

methods.name: buffalo_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that determines the image type and calls the appropriate upgrade routine.
